title: High-Level Design - Sales Insight data platform
executive_summary: Today CUSTOMER_001's daily sales report arrives around 11:00, and finance and operations often see different numbers for the same month. The reporting server is also out of support next year. We propose to move reporting to a data platform on AWS that collects sales and stock data every night, applies one agreed set of business rules, and feeds the existing dashboards. Managers will get the daily report by 08:00, everyone will work from the same numbers, and the unsupported server can be retired. The project runs in four phases over about 12 weeks.
background: Sales and stock reports run on an on-premises database with Qlik scripts. Reports are often late, the same figures differ between departments, and the business logic is known well by only one person. The server reaches end of support next year, so the reporting has to move in any case.

goals.success_measure: Finance and operations reports show the same monthly totals
All reports run from the new platform before end of support
Business rules documented and handed over to the IT team

in_scope: Collect data from the ERP (SOURCE_001) and the CRM (SOURCE_002)
Rebuild the business rules from the existing Qlik scripts in one shared place
Feed the existing BI dashboards from the new platform
Secure access with the company login
Training and handover to the IT team
Two weeks of Hyper-Care after go-live
out_of_scope: Changes to the ERP or CRM systems
solution_overview: Every night, data from the ERP and the CRM is copied into one secure storage area on AWS. It is then cleaned and combined using the same business rules for every department, so all reports use the same numbers. The existing BI tool reads the prepared data directly, so users keep the dashboards they know. Access uses the company login, and the whole process is monitored so the IT team is alerted if a nightly run fails.
architecture_note: The ERP and the CRM send data every night to a central storage area on AWS, where it is prepared and then read by the existing BI dashboards.

components.purpose: Central storage for raw and prepared data
components.business_value: One secure place for all reporting data

components.purpose: Collects, cleans and combines the data every night
components.business_value: Same business rules for every report

components.purpose: Lets the BI tool query the prepared data
Controls who can see which data
components.business_value: No new passwords; access managed centrally

why_this_approach: Keeps the dashboards users already know, so adoption is easy
Managed AWS services, so there are no servers to maintain
Costs grow with use instead of a large up-front purchase
Business rules are written down once and reused everywhere
security_operations: Access only through the company login, with permissions per team
Data encrypted in storage and in transit
Nightly runs are monitored and the IT team is alerted on failure
Data location requirements to be confirmed (see Q1)

phases.outcome: Data collected and prepared every night
Reports run from AWS, team trained

costs.note: Estimate to be prepared after design
